title.title: The Long Pour
title.overview: The Long Pour is a late 1920s New York Prohibition-era crime drama following the Italian-American Rinaldi family, who quietly control one of the city’s most sophisticated bootlegging empires. Led by Don Salvatore “Tore” Rinaldi, his wife, and his 5 sons, the family profits by maintaining and controlling Prohibition and carefully balancing supply, scarcity, and corruption to keep illegal alcohol highly lucrative.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: Don Salvatore Rinaldi and his major lieutenant (and eldest son, Giuseppe) run an underground saloon in Hell’s Kitchen, New York City. However, after the saloon is attacked by three gangsters, they find their hold on the illegal prohibition market is challenged

episodes.name: Kentucky Born & Bred
episodes.overview: Don Rinaldi’s sons Marco and David are eager to make themselves useful, offering to complete a deal for new Kentucky Bourbon, however the deal is crashed by the Haitian gangsters; Jacques Saint-Vil, Luc Desir and Yves Pierre.

episodes.name: Paid Off
episodes.overview: David and Marco are reprimanded for their actions, but their mother (and Salvatore’s wife), Giovanna supports them and gives them advice. Meanwhile, youngest son Franco accompanies eldest Giuseppe and Salvatore on a deal to win of the local news corporation “Empire State News Corp”, but struggle to charm their CEO, Arthur Costello.

episodes.name: Forgotten & Lost
episodes.overview: Salvatore’s middle child Lenny feels forgotten and ignored and decides to secure a big deal with a shady real estate developer. It turns bad and associates of the Haitians find out. David, hearing the commotion decides to help out.

episodes.name: Got Any Ideas?
episodes.overview: A family meeting is held. Salvatore opts to take the fight to the Haitians. Salvatore, Giuseppe, Lenny and David attack a building site owned by the Haitians. The fight is successful, but they only defeat the Haitians lackeys. They return to the Rinaldo Family Bar, which has been burned down. They watch as Yves, Jacques and Luc drive away. Franco and Lenny appear, Franco suggests waiting for the Haitians to come to them. Giuseppe and Salvatore rebuke it but the others think it may be a worth it idea. Giovanna is worried Franco is too young to be involved in the mafia, but Salvatore ignores her worries.

episodes.name: Sitting Still
episodes.overview: Ultimately, Salvatore and the Rinaldi’s opt to take Franco’s idea. They get a city permit to rebuild the bar by undercover Rinaldi operative James Brandy, who seems fed up with his position in the gang. Arthur Costello interviews Salvatore regarding the burning down of the bar, Salvatore threatens any associates of the Haitians, but Arthur manipulates his statement to villainise Salvatore, make it seem like he burned down his own bar for insurance or sympathy. Salvatore is pissed, David offers to handle it.

episodes.name: Cutting Loose Ends
episodes.overview: Salvatore goes with David and Lenny to take the fight to the Haitians associates, 3 men are killed; a deli owner, a train clerk and an engineer. Marco and Franco come up with new, funny ideas for designs of the new Rinaldi Bar.

episodes.name: The Showdown of The Year
episodes.overview: Franco investigates the whereabouts of the Haitians, and tracks them down to an oil field out of town. Salvatore takes everyone apart from Franco and Giovanni who are left with a gun at home. They confront the three Haitians and gunfight occurs. David is injured and carried away by Marco, Giuseppe kills Luc. Jacques downs the oil field in gasoline. Salvatore kills Jacques, but one of the stray bullets hits the gasoline and ignites the oil field. The chief operative of the oil field, George Miller arrives and blames Salvatore. Salvatore and Giuseppe steal George’s car and flee. The building explodes, Yves dies, George is left without his left leg. The season ends with a split screen: The Salvatore Family couped around David at St Jude’s River Hospital, and George also at the hospital recovering from the explosion, getting interviewed by Costello.

episodes.name: New Beginning’s
episodes.overview: March 1929. David has recovered and the Rinaldo bar has been rebuilt. Giovanna continues to worry about Franco’s involvement with the family. Salvatore, meanwhile, reads about Costello’s interview with Miller. He sends Lenny and Giuseppe to go find Miller, but they end up finding Miller’s old business partner, William Casey. Casey entices them to start a working relationship, which Salvatore agrees to. Casey reveals George owns a secret distilling factory in Albany.

episodes.name: Out Of Our Jurisdiction
episodes.overview: Salvatore takes David and Giuseppe to Albany to investigate the distilling factory. Lenny and Marco (+ Franco) are left to protect the business. The three arrive at Albany but find the distilling factory in disrepair. Then, they get ambushed by US Marshals, but manage to fight out of it and return to NYC. Meanwhile at NYC, Lenny and Marco are attacked at the bar by George’s thugs. Marco successfully kills most of them but Lenny is blindsided, but Franco manages to show up and save Lenny. Salvatore attempts to locate Casey but finds Casey is missing from the house.

episodes.name: Connections
episodes.overview: David and Lenny look for Casey, and find him hiding out at a warehouse in Manhattan. Suddenly, they are ambushed by security guards who work for the Empire State News Corp. They manage to survive, then take Casey to be interrogated. Salvatore finds out that George owns 3 oil refineries around NYC. Salvatore, Lenny, Marco and Casey attack one and steal some of the refined oil. Salvatore orders Giuseppe and Franco to find buyers. Salvatore also finds letters addressed to George by congressman Alexander Puckett, revealing George sells both refined oil and alcohol to government officials off the books.

episodes.name: The Shrink
episodes.overview: Giovanna takes Franco to a psychiatrist, where the results only deepen her worries. Rinaldo’s underground saloon is reopened, but Kentucky bourbon from the saloon is stolen. Salvatore tracks it down, alone, to a bootlegging tunnel associated with Miller. He steals back the bourbon, to little resistance, only to find the bourbon was poisoned. 6 people die, and Salvatore is completely devastated, as he and Giuseppe hide the bodies with the help of Casey.

episodes.name: A Deadly Secret
episodes.overview: George Miller finds out about the poison incident, and attempts to find the bodies. David and Lenny are on protection. Salvatore continues losing his mind, and goes to visit the shrink with Franco. Giuseppe begins investigating how George find out, and becomes suspicious of Casey. NYPD are alerted to the bodies and overwhelm David and Lenny, who are forced to run. The bodies are dug up. Arthur Costello publishes a story implicating Salvatore in the murders.

episodes.name: The Whole Deal
episodes.overview: The remaining 5 plan on what to do. Lenny and Giuseppe sneak into ESNC’S headquarters and find the real alcohol distillery is being ignored by the NYPD In exchange for some of the cold brews. The infiltrate Costello’s office and find the distillery’s location in Rochester. The two go up to Rochester themselves, but find half the RPD on their way in. They manage to shoot their way into the distillery, stealing the bourbon. The remaining bourbon is used to ignite the place. The two then lure the rest of the Rochester police department into the distillery, and ignite the bourbon. The two drive away as the distillery is blown to pieces. George Miller watches from over the hill, amused, and totally unfazed he just witnessed the deaths of hundreds of police and thugs.

episodes.name: Hunted Down
episodes.overview: A particularly brutal thunderstorm sets over NYC. Salvatore, still worrying over Giovanna and Franco decides to hunt down Casey. Salvatore goes alone, and faces the wrath of the NYPD, brutalising his way into the sheriff’s office, where he finds Casey’s address. He turns up, kills his security detail and confronts Casey. Suddenly, an explosion outside draws the attention of Salvatore, as Casey runs. A chase across NYC ensues. NYPD intervene, as Casey runs to congressman Puckett’s house. Puckett attempts to reason with Casey, but Casey holds Puckett at gunpoint. George arrives and attempts to reason with Casey. Realising it can’t be done, he instructs Casey to kill Puckett, then leaves. Salvatore shoots Casey, saves Puckett. Puckett, furious, decides to cut ties with George and offers to work with Salvatore. Salvatore agrees.

episodes.name: Reunited At Last
episodes.overview: Puckett instructs the government that they are cutting ties with George Miller, and they will only be getting bourbon from Salvatore Rinaldo. Ohio congressman Dennis Ramsey takes an exception to this. Puckett meets with Salvatore and believes he can get a deal to get Franco and Giovanna out of jail, if Salvatore can deal with Ramsey. Puckett reveals that, along with working Miller, is pushing civic reform, something Puckett is wholly against. Salvatore, Marco and Lenny fly to Ohio, and meet Ramsey at his ranch. Salvatore kills Ramsey, and they head back to New York. However, Salvatore was sloppy and left evidence, meaning they are now wanted by the Ohio police department. Costello, meanwhile, meets with Miller and warns Miller their operation is slowly becoming more dangerous. Costello wants a way out, Miller “agrees”. However, Miller kills several of Costello’s reporters on the way out. Giovanna and Franco are released from jail.

episodes.name: Revenge In Many Forms
episodes.overview: Franco has seemingly lost his mind, so Salvatore takes him fishing. Costello, believing Salvatore to be behind the murders of his reporters, brings his henchmen to the beach, a shootout develops, Salvatore is overwhelmed but Franco comes to his defence, ruthlessly killing tens of men. Salvatore begins to develop similar worries to giovanna. David and Lenny sign a contract with Puckett which involves a huge government party for the next Saturday.

episodes.name: End of Year Party
episodes.overview: November 1929. Congress end of year party. The Rinaldo’s serve the bourbon. Arthur Costello begins a smear campaign, claiming the rinaldo’s killed his reporters and that it’s open war on the streets of New York. Puckett is worried, and orders Marco and Giuseppe to keep watch at the party. The party, of course goes awry, when a Pennsylvania congressman is shot, and suddenly miller’s henchman storm the building. A gunfight begins, casualties are taken and Puckett is left for dead

episodes.name: Play The Blame Game
episodes.overview: The final confrontation. Puckett is hospitalised after being shot in the prior episode. Costello is informed by NYPD that they believe miller killed his reporters. Costello confronts miller, miller kills Costello and announces he is taking over Costello’s empire. Salvatore hears miller has taken over ESNC’s headquarters and sends Marco & Lenny over there. Marco and Lenny fight their way in, confront Miller and kill him. They then frame it as a suicide, and blow up the building. Puckett reads about what has happened, and curses Salvatore.

episodes.name: The Peak of American Society
episodes.overview: February 1930. Salvatore and Giuseppe travel to Washington, D.C to try and smooth things over with congress. Puckett confronts them, telling them he knows that Miller and Costello died at the hands of them. Salvatore offers the finest bourbon, Puckett refuses. Franco is introduced to the shooting range by Lenny. New York City mayor Frank Livelli meets with Puckett to craft ideas on how to take down Salvatore.

episodes.name: The Antics of the Rinaldi Family
episodes.overview: The Rinaldi Family rob a bar, but find half the NYPD coming out, Giovanna hires NYPD lieutenant Marcus Holstein to become the families spy.

episodes.name: The Incompetence of Local Police
episodes.overview: NYPD raid the bar but Holstein tips them off and they manage to wheel away any illegal substances before they arrive. Puckett reprimands Livelli for the uselessness of his police. Puckett announces he will temporarily take control of the NYPD, and maybe New York City.

episodes.name: New Found Love
episodes.overview: Lenny has found a new girl, and she is truly remarkable. However, Marla doesn’t approve of his gang life. Marco and Franco try to break them up. Meanwhile, NYPD begin doing illegal frisks, stop and searches and screening of any Italian man or woman in New York City. Local press begin reporting, and Salvatore begins marketing the Rinaldo bar as a safe haven for Italians.

episodes.name: Competition
episodes.overview: Livelli and Puckett shift strategies. They attack one of Salvatore’s competitors. Salvatore sends Lenny and Giuseppe to try and save them but find massacred bodies. Livelli and Puckett begin setting up the saloon. Puckett praises Livelli and allows him to restart work as mayor.

episodes.name: A Lovely Dinner
episodes.overview: Salvatore is stressed about the Livelli/Puckett saloon. Giovanna invites Marla over to dinner at the bar. Things go wrong when NYPD raid the bar. Salvatore, Marco and Lenny defend the bar, but Livelli and Puckett steak high grade liquor and bourbon, which they take back to their saloon. The 2 open the saloon, with long lines and happy customers. Marla is distraught after Lenny comes back with blood all over him

episodes.name: New Strategies for Old Friends
episodes.overview: Salvatore is stressed about the Livelli/Puckett saloon. Giovanna invites Marla over to dinner at the bar. Things go wrong when NYPD raid the bar. Salvatore, Marco and Lenny defend the bar, but Livelli and Puckett steak high grade liquor and bourbon, which they take back to their saloon. The 2 open the saloon, with long lines and happy customers. Marla is distraught after Lenny comes back with blood all over him

episodes.name: The Turning Tide
episodes.overview: Franco goes behind his mother’s back to buy a pistol from a shady weapons dealer. The dealer sets him up, attempts to kill him but Franco kills him, steals the weapons and evades the NYPD. Salvatore reprimands him but Franco shows him the high calibre weapons and Salvatore changes mood. Meanwhile, David and Giuseppe do some advertising, continuing to upset the Livelli/Puckett business. The two return to city hall and come up a new idea. An idea to get.. closer to Salvatore

episodes.name: The Road to Reelection
episodes.overview: 1930 Midterms. Puckett is somewhat unpopular with the New York public. Needing a boost, Puckett goads Salvatore into attacking him, but Salvatore sends Marco and Lenny. Marco attempts to kill Puckett but Puckett survives and the NYPD swarm Marco and Lenny, who just survive. Puckett becomes deeply popular. Livelli reveals that one news corporation isn’t exactly, hyping Puckett up. Puckett personally goes to kill the reporter involved, but Salvatore and Giuseppe intervene. In the commotion, the NYPD rig the building and blow it up, the reporter dies but Salvatore and Giuseppe just escape. Livelli’s popularity steeply declines as the crime in New York continues to rise.

episodes.name: Who Lives, Who Dies, Who Tells Your Story
episodes.overview: Election Day. Salvatore looks for buyers on the weapons Franco secured. Salvatore’s bar continues to get more people, as Puckett and Livelli’s bar goes bankrupt. News corporations around town reveal Puckett and Livelli’s association. Puckett is furious and orders suppression of the media by the NYPD. However, the NYPD refuse, and Holstein secretly alerts Salvatore to where the two are. Everyone but Franco storm city hall, with no NYPD, they manage to get through the building with ease. Puckett, seeing the public shift against him, abandons Livelli to go kill his opponent. Salvatore finds Livelli. Unpopular and alone, Livelli flees to find Puckett. Puckett kills his opponent, dumps his body but Livelli sees. Puckett kills Livelli and dumps his body. Salvatore arrives to see Livelli’s body, but Puckett is gone. Puckett is reelected, however his power has diminished and he has no control over NYC. The weapons deal is conducted, and the Rinaldi Family celebrate Livelli’s death.

From drug busts to routine traffic stops, you never know what to expect, but these officers are ready 24/7 to keep their communities safe.

similar.overview: Have you ever found yourself on a Wikipedia deep dive on the weird side of the internet? In this show, weird thing enthusiasts Ryan and Shane take turns presenting their latest fascinations to each other covering everything unusual, unexplained, and unhinged.

similar.overview: Two amateur detectives in an Oxfordshire village discover dying fish in their river. When they contact the water company for answers, the company's odd, evasive response prompts them to launch an investigation that continues today.

similar.title: The Fortune
similar.overview: Amanda Blakefield's life is a happy one, with her husband Jimmy and their son Luke. But when Amanda is left an enormous inheritance by a man she has neither met nor heard of before, her life starts to fall apart. Amanda becomes embroiled in the world of the Worralls, where Martin Worrall is head of a family bound in past secrets. As Amanda is drawn further and further into past events and relationships, all of their lives are turned upside down.
